behavior.ownership: Existing perform/readPrivate/query remain the only command/poll path. One click-preparation ref and synchronous busy guard, no dependency/framework/generic state machine/new owner.
behavior.interruptions: Lost response/error/BUSY/INDETERMINATE/UNAVAILABLE/401/logout/unmount/abort/expiry stop preparation. Recovery GET is same known ID, clears preparation and never continues Connect. Reload discovers current once and pins known nonconfirmed operations to exact IDs. Only zero-ID UNAVAILABLE/NONE means empty fresh current.
behavior.limits: 30000ms config, 900000ms OAuth, 500ms background polling, retry=false retained. Expired timer is not rearmed while already-expired recovery is in progress.
behavior.auth: No command/auth_read/refresh/inference on mount; existing current GET is local operation recovery only. Fixed device URL requires explicit operator click, no popup effect or secret input. Configured/SAVED never means provider/inference ready. Backend already does terminal local auth readback, so no extra frontend auth_read was added.
behavior.controls: Logout appears only with SAVED/local grant evidence. Same-ID Cancel hides challenge immediately and waits for confirmed drain. Cache/late/reload/error/expiry/background regressions retained. Exact only supported selection remains openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh.
